title: Finite-dimensional normed spaces over locally compact fields are proper
statement: Let l be a prime, let Q_l be the l-adic field [def-weil-l-adic-numbers], and let E/Q_l be a field extension [def-pc-field-extension] finite-dimensional as a Q_l-vector space of degree dim_Q_l E [def-weil-vector-space-dimension], equipped with the norm induced by its extending l-adic absolute value [lem-weil-l-adic-extension-absolute-value]. Then E is a proper metric space: every closed bounded ball in E is compact.
